content: MCP Apps in Claude (official docs, fetched 2026-11-27): rendered on web, Desktop, iOS (WKWebView) in sandboxed iframe at {sha256(serverUrl)[0:32]}.claudemcpcontent.com when ui.domain set; app.callServerTool calls server tools without user prompt; app.sendMessage max 8,000 chars and needs user agreement; app tools (view-registered, 100,000 chars result, 45s) need remote connector + unified experience and are not available in every org; custom connectors show an Unverified mark; _meta.ui.visibility ['app'] is not a security boundary (model may still call the tool).
